Usage: resecta-data verify-hashes [OPTIONS]

  Verify every build artifact matches its lockfile entry.

  Fails if:   - A lockfile entry has no corresponding file (unless --built-only).   - A file has no
  lockfile entry.   - A file's hash does not match the lockfile.

  With --built-only, lockfile entries absent from the build tree are listed as skipped and do not
  fail the check — for hosts that build a subset of the artifacts (a fresh checkout without the
  large fetched sources) while still proving every built byte matches the lock.

Options:
  --build-dir DIRECTORY  [required]
  --lockfile FILE        [required]
  --built-only           Verify only artifacts present in the build tree; lockfile entries with no
                         built file are reported as skipped instead of failing. Hash mismatches and
                         unlisted artifacts still fail.
  --help                 Show this message and exit.
